lessons.title: Why MLPs Struggle with Images
lessons.description: Understand the parameter explosion and loss of 2D spatial locality when flattening image pixels into standard MLPs.

lessons.title: Convolutions, Kernels, & Feature Maps
lessons.description: Master sliding kernels, dot products, stride, padding, edge detection filters, and output feature map dimensionality.

lessons.title: Pooling & Hierarchical Feature Learning
lessons.description: Downsample feature maps with Max Pooling and Average Pooling. Understand translation invariance and receptive fields.

lessons.title: Landmark CNNs & Transfer Learning
lessons.description: Trace CNN evolution from AlexNet and VGG to ResNet's skip connections. Master transfer learning on pre-trained backbones.
